jobs.occupation: Postdoc - Innovative Biopredictive Dissolution (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionHow can experimental dissolution science and digital approaches help us better understand the performance of tomorrow's oral medicines? We are seeking a curious and motivated Postdoc to join our Biopharmaceutics and Dissolution Sciences team in Biberach. You will lead a research project focused on advancing biopredictive dissolution approaches for challenging compounds and advanced oral formulations.Combining hands-on laboratory research, mechanistic interpretation and modern digital tools, you will explore how drug substance properties, formulation attributes and experimental conditions influence in vitro performance and support oral formulation development.Working with multidisciplinary experts and state-of-the-art technologies, you will build your independent research profile and gain experience in pharmaceutical development, with opportunities for peer-reviewed publications and international scientific exchange.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is limited for 2 years.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.Note: To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.Tasks & responsibilities- You independently design, conduct and evaluate studies to develop physiologically relevant, biopredictive dissolution approaches for challenging compounds and advanced oral formulations.- By investigating dissolution, supersaturation and precipitation, you derive mechanistic insights into how drug substance properties, formulation attributes, manufacturing variables and test conditions influence in vitro performance.- Building on these insights, you apply the developed approaches to drug development questions and critically assess their applicability and limitations.- Your findings enable you to develop practical recommendations and best practices for oral drug product development.- Using digital, data-driven and computational tools, you analyze complex datasets and support evidence-based decisions.- As part of a multidisciplinary environment, you collaborate with experts in formulation development, biopharmaceutics, pharmacokinetics, modeling and regulatory sciences.- Through scientific reports, peer-reviewed publications and presentations, you communicate your research findings to internal teams and at international conferences.Requirements- PhD in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Food Science or a related discipline.- Hands-on experience in dissolution testing, oral formulation development, biopharmaceutics or a related experimental field. Experience with poorly soluble compounds, amorphous solid dispersions, supersaturation or precipitation is advantageous.- Experience in analytical method development using techniques such as HPLC/UPLC, UV spectroscopy or comparable methods. Experience with solid-state or particle characterization, imaging or laboratory automation is advantageous.- Sound understanding of oral drug absorption and its relationship to drug substance properties, formulation performance and gastrointestinal conditions. Knowledge of physiologically relevant dissolution testing, IVIVR/IVIVC, PBBM/PBPK modeling or regulatory biopharmaceutics is advantageous.- Ability to independently plan and conduct experiments, critically analyze complex datasets and draw clear scientific conclusions. Interest or experience in computational tools, scientific informatics, knowledge management or AI-enabled knowledge discovery is desirable. Experience with statistical data analysis is advantageous.- Scientific curiosity, a proactive and well-organized working style, and the ability to collaborate across disciplines and functions. Excellent scientific communication, presentation and technical writing skills in English. German language skills are advantageous but not required.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What We OfferWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 11, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to November 04, 2026 are guaranteed to be considered.Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid of November till end of NovemberStep 3: On-site interviews beginning mid of DecemberPlease include the following documents when applying for this position: Certificates and Documentation.

jobs.occupation: Senior Service Designer, Food Systems & Fulfillment (f/m/x) (Industrie-, Produktdesigner/in)
jobs.description: At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleThe Enterprise UX practice at HelloFresh is a cross-functional team that brings physical and digital product and service experiences to life through strategic research, service design, prototyping, and storytelling. We are dedicated to transforming enterprise ways of working by applying structured methods like Definition Sprints, Service Blueprinting, and AS-IS and TO-BE mapping, creating meaningful & effective enterprise experiences to shape the future of HelloFresh’s Supply Chain.As a Senior Service Designer, you will leverage your research and service design expertise to shape compelling visions for both product and process improvements. You will deeply investigate current ways of working—identifying key data archetypes, mapping AS-IS states, and collaboratively defining desired TO-BE workflows. jobs.occupation: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager (all genders) (Marketingfachkraft/-assistent/in)
jobs.description: At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleFor our global Mature Customer Marketing team in Berlin, we are looking for a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the lifecycle strategy for one these topics: merchandising, or partnerships & retail media. The Mature Customer Marketing team sits within the HelloFresh Group’s Global Customer Lifecycle organization. Our mission is simple: keep active customers active, and make sure they get the most out of their subscription — across our 6 brands, 18 countries and 30 markets.As a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you’ll be a critical link between strategy and execution, partnering closely with CRM, Product Marketing, Physical Product, Tech and local marketing teams to design, brief and scale programs that keep our customers engaged with their subscription.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll do- Own the lifecycle strategy deployment for your topic area and translate it into programs and campaigns that keep customers engaged with their subscription- Partner with Product Marketing, Physical Product and Tech to spot opportunities that improve the customer experience and support your topic’s goals- Brief campaigns end-to-end to CRM Operations and Creative teams, ensuring messaging, targeting and execution meet our lifecycle and brand standards- Work with local market teams across our 30 markets to adapt and roll out global strategy, balancing consistency with local relevance- Use data to test, measure and continuously optimize campaign performance- Track and report on the health of your topic area, flagging risks and opportunities to the wider Customer Engagement team- Support cross-topic initiatives across the team as neededWhat you’ll bring- Strong project management skills, with experience managing complex campaigns across a high number of cross-functional stakeholders, including CRM Operations, Creative, Tech, and local teams.- Strong creative briefing skills — experience translating marketing objectives, audience insights, and messaging needs into clear, inspiring briefs that give creative teams the direction and context needed to deliver strong work.- Commercial acumen — experience operating in a commercial function (not necessarily CRM), with the ability to bridge lifecycle marketing thinking with commercial opportunities.- A successful experience (3+ years) in CRM, lifecycle marketing, product marketing or a similar role, ideally in a subscription, e-commerce or FMCG environment- An analytical mindset — comfortable using data to inform decisions and optimize campaigns- Ability to manage multiple priorities independently, across global and local stakeholders- Fluent in English; notions of German, French, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian or Danish is a plus- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business or a related fieldWhat we offerCompensation & Financial Wellbeing- You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.- Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.- Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.Health & Wellbeing- Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.- Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.Flexibility & Work-Life- Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.- Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.- Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.Career & Development- Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.Culture & Environment- Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.- We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.Are you up for the challenge?Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Customer-Relationship-Management (CRM), Marketing-Management, Projektmanagement
